parents.Domain:
structure Domain (kind : Kind) (c : Context) (budget : Nat) : Prop where
  owner : ∃ account, c.world.get? c.target = some account
  ordinaryValue : c.apparentValue = c.value
  calldataFit : c.calldata.size < UInt256.size
  budgetFit : budget < 2^128
  bounded : AccountedState.Bounded budget (worldSlot c.world c.target)
  safe : FundedDomain.EnabledSafe (DirectAdmission.target kind) (worldSlot c.world c.target)
parents.PSubmit:
def PSubmit (kind : Kind) (code : ByteArray) : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Context) (budget : Nat), c.code = code → Domain kind c budget →
    ∀ (created : Std.TreeSet AccountAddress compare) (world : AccountMap .EVM)
      (gas : UInt256) (substate : Substate) (success : Bool) (out : ByteArray),
      c.result = .ok (created, world, gas, substate, success, out) →
      SubmitObserved kind c created world substate success out
parents.PDrain:
def PDrain (kind : Kind) (code : ByteArray) : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Context) (queue : List (QueueInvariant.Record kind)) (budget : Nat),
    c.code = code → DirectDrain.Domain kind c queue budget →
    ∀ (created : Std.TreeSet AccountAddress compare) (world : AccountMap .EVM)
      (gas : UInt256) (substate : Substate) (success : Bool) (out : ByteArray),
      c.result = .ok (created, world, gas, substate, success, out) →
      DirectDrain.Observed kind c world success out queue
parents.RuntimeControl:
def RuntimeControl (kind : Kind) (code : ByteArray) : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Context) (budget : Nat), c.code = code → Domain kind c budget →
    ∀ (created : Std.TreeSet AccountAddress compare) (world : AccountMap .EVM)
      (gas : UInt256) (substate : Substate) (success : Bool) (out : ByteArray),
      c.result = .ok (created, world, gas, substate, success, out) →
      DirectControl.Observed kind c created world substate success out
parents.PControl:
def PControl (kind : Kind) (code init : ByteArray) : Prop :=
  RuntimeControl kind code ∧ DirectInitialization.Initializes kind init ∧ SystemProgress.Progress code
parents.psubmit1_direct: theorem psubmit1_direct (kind : Kind) : PSubmit kind (runtimeCode kind)
parents.pdrain1_direct: theorem pdrain1_direct (kind : Kind) : PDrain kind (runtimeCode kind)
parents.pcontrol1_direct:
theorem pcontrol1_direct (kind : Kind) :
    PControl kind (runtimeCode kind) (Initialization.initCode kind)

inventory.exact_statement:
inductive Step : AccountMap .EVM → Nat → AccountMap .EVM → Prop where
  | transaction (c : RefundAccounting.Context) (account : Account .EVM)
      (admission : TransactionFunding.Admission c account)
      {world : AccountMap .EVM} {substate : Substate} {success : Bool} {gas : UInt256}
      (executed : c.result = .ok (world,substate,success,gas)) :
      Step c.world 0 world
  | system (c : MessageCall.Context)
      (sender : c.caller = Eip8282.Audit.EvmRunner.sysAddr) (zero : c.value = ⟨0⟩)
      {created : Std.TreeSet AccountAddress compare} {world : AccountMap .EVM}
      {gas : UInt256} {substate : Substate} {success : Bool} {out : ByteArray}
      (executed : c.result = .ok (created,world,gas,substate,success,out)) :
      Step c.world 0 world
  | credit (world : AccountMap .EVM) (recipient : AccountAddress) (amount : UInt256) :
      Step world amount.toNat (world.increaseBalance .EVM recipient amount)

important_nonpremises: Runtime safety does not assume paid admission, successful execution, gas/fuel sufficiency, permission, caller class, completed mathematical quote, expected storage or logs. Actual .ok completion and independent domains are required.
Actual init success IS a premise. Successful SYSTEM completion IS a proved conclusion under separate progress resources.
No correctness theorem assumes protocol supply ceiling directly; preserving safe across all calls requires independent funding/history closure.
Queue existence can describe arbitrary physical words; authentic provenance and chronological linkage require extracted history.
limits: No builds, Lean elaboration, provider/network calls or repository mutations performed. Receipt evidence inspected and source hashes compared.
Standard Lean axioms do not certify agreement of pinned EVMYulLean with any external normative fork, hashing implementation, compiler or kernel implementation.
